question: What freedoms are guaranteed to citizens under Article 17 of the Constitution of Nepal?
reference_answer: Article 17 guarantees six freedoms: freedom of opinion and expression; freedom to assemble peaceably without arms; freedom to form political parties; freedom to form trade unions and associations; freedom of movement and residence; and freedom to practice any profession, occupation, or business.

question: नेपालको संविधानको धारा १६ मा सम्मानपूर्वक बाँच्न पाउने हक सम्बन्धमा के व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: धारा १६ अनुसार प्रत्येक व्यक्तिलाई सम्मानपूर्वक बाँच्न पाउने हक हुनेछ र कसैलाई पनि मृत्युदण्डको सजाय दिने गरी कानून बनाइने छैन।
notes: Art 16 right to dignity in Nepali

question: Under what conditions does the Constitution prohibit capital punishment?
reference_answer: Under Article 16(2), the Constitution explicitly provides that no law shall be made providing for the death penalty.

question: What rights are provided regarding clean environment under Article 30?
reference_answer: Under Article 30, each citizen has the right to live in a clean and healthy environment, and victims of environmental pollution or degradation have the right to obtain compensation from the polluter.

question: संविधानको धारा ३१ अनुसार शिक्षा सम्बन्धी हकमा के के पर्दछन्?
reference_answer: प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आधारभूत शिक्षामा पहुँचको हक, आधारभूत तहसम्मको शिक्षा अनिवार्य र निःशुल्क तथा माध्यमिक तहसम्मको शिक्षा निःशुल्क पाउने हक हुनेछ।

question: Can a person be subjected to physical or mental torture during investigation according to the Constitution?
reference_answer: No, Article 22 provides that no person who is arrested or held in detention shall be subjected to physical or mental torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment.

question: What are the constitutional requirements for presenting an arrested person before a judicial authority?
reference_answer: Under Article 20(3), any person arrested shall be produced before the judicial authority within twenty-four hours of arrest, excluding the journey time.

question: संविधानको धारा २७ मा सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धमा कुन कुरा उल्लेख छ?
reference_answer: प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आफ्नो वा सार्वजनिक सरोकारको कुनै पनि विषयको सूचना माग्ने र पाउने हक हुनेछ। तर कानून बमोजिम गोप्य राख्नुपर्ने सूचना दिन बाध्य हुने छैन।
notes: Art 27 right to info in Nepali

question: What are the fundamental rights of consumers under Article 44?
reference_answer: Article 44 grants every consumer the right to obtain quality goods and services, and the right to compensation in accordance with law for damage caused by sub-standard goods or services.

question: What are the duties of citizens established under Article 48 of the Constitution?
reference_answer: Article 48 states that citizens must safeguard nationality, sovereignty, and integrity; abide by the Constitution; render compulsory service when required; and protect public property.

question: What are the different types of employment recognized under Section 10 of the Labour Act 2017?
reference_answer: Section 10 classifies employment into regular employment, work-based employment, time-bound employment, casual employment, and part-time employment.
notes: Labour Act Section 10 types of employment

question: श्रम ऐन २०७४ अनुसार कामदारको परीक्षणकाल कति अवधिको हुन्छ?
reference_answer: श्रम ऐनको दफा ११ अनुसार रोजगारदाताले कामदारलाई ६ महिनाको परीक्षणकालमा राख्न सक्नेछ।
notes: Labour Act Section 11 probation in Nepali

question: What is the maximum duration for a probationary period under the Labour Act?
reference_answer: Under Section 11, the probationary period shall not exceed six months.

question: How much paid sick leave is an employee entitled to each year under the Labour Act?
reference_answer: Under Section 43, a labourer who has completed one year of service is entitled to fully paid sick leave up to twelve days per year.

question: श्रम ऐन बमोजिम सुत्केरी बिदा कति दिन पाउने व्यवस्था छ?
reference_answer: दफा ४५ अनुसार महिला श्रमिकले सुत्केरी हुनु अघि वा पछि गरी कम्तीमा ६० दिन पूर्ण पारिश्रमिकसहित कुल १४ हप्ता (९८ दिन) सम्म प्रसूति बिदा पाउने व्यवस्था छ।
notes: Labour Act maternity leave in Nepali

question: Can an employer terminate an employee without notice under the Labour Act 2017?
reference_answer: Section 144 requires prior notice before termination depending on length of service (e.g. 30 days for service exceeding one year), unless termination is for gross misconduct under disciplinary provisions.

question: What are the overtime pay requirements under the Labour Act?
reference_answer: Under Section 31, if a labourer works overtime beyond 8 hours a day or 48 hours a week, they must be paid at 1.5 times their regular remuneration rate.

question: श्रम ऐन २०७४ अनुसार सार्वजनिक बिदामा काम लगाउँदा के सुविधा दिनुपर्छ?
reference_answer: सार्वजनिक बिदाको दिन काममा लगाएमा सट्टा बिदा वा अतिरिक्त पारिश्रमिक भुक्तानी गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था छ।
notes: Labour Act public holiday in Nepali

question: Under what conditions can an enterprise retrench workers due to financial distress?
reference_answer: Under Section 145, an enterprise undergoing economic problems or reduction in business can retrench workers by providing notice to the Labour Office and paying compensation of one month's basic remuneration per year of service.

question: What is the required membership threshold to form a trade union in an enterprise?
reference_answer: Section 116 provides that a collective bargaining committee or enterprise-level union can be established by workers in accordance with prescribed percentage support (at least 25% of workers).

question: What constitutes a valid contract under Section 504 of the Muluki Civil Code?
reference_answer: A valid contract requires mutual agreement between two or more competent persons with free consent, lawful object, lawful consideration, and intention to create legal relations.

question: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता अनुसार करार गर्न अयोग्य व्यक्ति को को हुन्?
reference_answer: दफा ५०६ अनुसार नाबालिग (१८ वर्ष उमेर पूरा नभएको) र होस ठेगान नभएको (अस्वस्थ चित्त भएको) व्यक्ति करार गर्न अयोग्य मानिन्छन्।
notes: Civil Code contract competency in Nepali

question: What is the statutory age of majority in Nepal under the Civil Code?
reference_answer: Under Section 36 of the Muluki Civil Code, a person who has attained eighteen years of age is deemed to be a major.

question: What rules apply to claiming a surname under Section 111 of the Civil Code?
reference_answer: Section 111 provides that a child has the right to use the surname of either the father or mother, or both, and a person whose parents cannot be traced is entitled to use a surname of their choice.

question: सम्बन्ध विच्छेदका लागि पति र पत्नी दुवैले अदालतमा निवेदन दिन पाउने व्यवस्था कुन दफामा छ?
reference_answer: मुलुकी देवानी संहिताको दफा ९३ र ९४ मा पति र पत्नीले आपसी सहमति वा निश्चित आधारहरूमा सम्बन्ध विच्छेदका लागि निवेदन दिन पाउने व्यवस्था गरिएको छ।

question: What is the status of a contract entered into by coercion or undue influence?
reference_answer: Under Section 517 of the Civil Code, a contract concluded through coercion, fraud, misrepresentation, or undue influence is voidable at the option of the aggrieved party.

question: What happens when a person dies intestate without any heirs under the Civil Code?
reference_answer: Under the inheritance provisions of the Civil Code, if an intestate deceased person leaves no surviving heir within recognized degrees of relationship, their property devolves upon the Government of Nepal.

question: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता अनुसार घरबहाल करार कति रकमभन्दा माथि भएमा लिखित रूपमा गर्नुपर्छ?
reference_answer: दफा ३८७ अनुसार घरबहाल सम्झौता लिखित रूपमा हुनुपर्दछ र मासिक बहाल रकम तोकिएको सीमा भन्दा बढी भएमा दर्ता गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था छ।

question: What constitutes the crime of murder (culpable homicide) under the Penal Code?
reference_answer: Under Section 177 of the Muluki Penal Code, intentionally causing the death of another person constitutes murder, punishable by imprisonment for life.

question: मुलुकी अपराध संहिता अनुसार ज्यान मार्ने उद्योग (प्रयास) गरेमा के सजाय हुन्छ?
reference_answer: दफा १८३ अनुसार कसैले ज्यान मार्ने नियतले कुनै काम गरी ज्यान मर्नबाट जोगिएमा दश वर्षसम्म कैद र एक लाख रुपैयाँसम्म जरिवाना हुन सक्छ।
notes: Penal Code attempted murder in Nepali

question: What is the penalty for kidnapping or hostage-taking under Section 211 of the Penal Code?
reference_answer: Section 211 and 212 prescribe imprisonment for seven to fifteen years and a fine for kidnapping or taking hostage.

question: How is the offense of defamation (libel and slander) defined and punished under Section 307?
reference_answer: Section 307 penalizes defamation, stating that making false or harmful imputations against a person's reputation carries imprisonment up to two years or a fine up to twenty thousand rupees, or both.

question: आपराधिक विश्वासघात (criminal breach of trust) सम्बन्धी कसूरमा कस्तो सजायको व्यवस्था छ?
reference_answer: दफा २५२ अनुसार आपराधिक विश्वासघात गर्ने व्यक्तिलाई पाँच वर्षसम्म कैद र पचास हजार रुपैयाँसम्म जरिवाना हुन सक्ने व्यवस्था छ।
notes: Penal Code breach of trust in Nepali

question: What constitute offenses against state sovereignty or territorial integrity under the Penal Code?
reference_answer: Section 49 penalizes any act intended to undermine the independence, sovereignty, or territorial integrity of Nepal with imprisonment for life.

question: What procedures must be followed for the examination of a corpse under Section 20 of the Criminal Procedure Code?
reference_answer: Section 20 mandates that if a person dies by homicide, suicide, or suspicious circumstances, the investigating police officer must inspect the corpse in the presence of local witnesses and send it for post-mortem examination.

question: फौजदारी कार्यविधि संहिता अनुसार पक्राउ पूर्जी बिना कुन अवस्थामा पक्राउ गर्न सकिन्छ?
reference_answer: दफा ९ अनुसार तत्काल भाग्न सक्ने, प्रमाण नष्ट गर्न सक्ने वा गम्भीर अपराध गर्दै गरेको अवस्थामा पक्राउ पूर्जी बिना नै पक्राउ गरी २४ घण्टाभित्र अदालतमा उपस्थित गराउनु पर्दछ।
notes: CrPC arrest without warrant in Nepali

question: Under what conditions may a court grant release on bail or recognizance during trial?
reference_answer: Under Section 67 and 68, the court may release an accused on bail or personal recognizance depending on the gravity of the offense, past conduct, and likelihood of appearance, except for offenses punishable by life imprisonment.

question: What is the statutory limitation (statute of limitations) for filing a First Information Report (FIR)?
reference_answer: Section 33 sets out the limitation period for reporting offenses, generally requiring reports to be filed within prescribed periods from the date of the crime or discovery.

question: What penalties apply to a public servant accepting bribery under Section 3 of the Prevention of Corruption Act?
reference_answer: Section 3 imposes graduated penalties of fines matching the corrupt amount and imprisonment ranging from three months up to eight years depending on the sum accepted as a bribe.

question: भ्रष्टाचार निवारण ऐन २०५९ अनुसार गैरकानूनी सम्पत्ति आर्जन (अवैध सम्पत्ति) मा के सजाय हुन्छ?
reference_answer: दफा २० अनुसार सार्वजनिक पद धारण गरेको व्यक्तिले आफ्नो आयस्रोत भन्दा अस्वाभाविक सम्पत्ति आर्जन गरेको प्रमाणित भएमा बिगो जफत गरी दुई वर्षसम्म कैद र जरिवाना हुन्छ।
notes: Corruption Act disproportionate assets in Nepali

question: Does the Prevention of Corruption Act punish false or fraudulent auditing by licensed auditors?
reference_answer: Yes, Section 12 penalizes auditors who prepare false or fabricated audit reports of government offices or public entities with imprisonment up to three months and fines.

question: When is an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) mandatory under the Environment Protection Act 2019?
reference_answer: Under Section 3 and 7, any proponent proposing a developmental project prescribed by rules must prepare a brief environmental study, Initial Environmental Examination (IEE), or Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) before commencement.

question: वातावरण संरक्षण ऐन २०७६ अनुसार प्रदूषण गर्ने व्यक्तिले कसरी क्षतिपूर्ति तिर्नुपर्छ?
reference_answer: दफा ३१ र ३२ अनुसार वातावरण प्रदूषण वा हानीबाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिलाई प्रदूषकले उचित क्षतिपूर्ति भराइदिनुपर्ने र वातावरण पुनःस्थापना खर्च व्यहोर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था छ।
notes: Environment Act polluter pays in Nepali

question: In what sectors is foreign investment prohibited under the Foreign Investment and Technology Transfer Act (FITTA)?
reference_answer: Under Section 3 and the Negative List Schedule of FITTA 2019, foreign investment is prohibited in sectors such as cottage industries, arms and ammunition, retail business, real estate, and poultry farming.

question: औद्योगिक व्यवसाय ऐन २०७६ अनुसार उद्योगहरूलाई लगानीको आधारमा कसरी वर्गीकरण गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: ऐनको दफा १७ अनुसार उद्योगहरूलाई लघु उद्यम, घरेलु उद्योग, साना उद्योग, मझौला उद्योग र ठूला उद्योग गरी ५ वर्गमा वर्गीकरण गरिएको छ।

question: What repatriation rights does a foreign investor possess under FITTA 2019?
reference_answer: Under Section 20, foreign investors have the right to repatriate dividends, capital gains, principal and interest on foreign loans, and royalties in foreign currency.

question: What investigative powers are vested in the National Human Rights Commission under Section 4?
reference_answer: Section 4 authorizes the NHRC to summon individuals, examine witnesses under oath, order document production, enter premises without prior notice during investigations, and inspect detention facilities.

question: मानव अधिकार आयोगले पीडितलाई क्षतिपूर्ति दिन नेपाल सरकारलाई सिफारिस गर्न सक्छ?
reference_answer: दफा १६ अनुसार मानव अधिकार उल्लंघनबाट पीडित व्यक्तिलाई क्षतिपूर्ति उपलब्ध गराउन आयोगले सम्बन्धित निकाय वा नेपाल सरकारसमक्ष सिफारिस गर्न सक्ने स्पष्ट कानूनी व्यवस्था छ।

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern right to equality?

question: How does the law regulate right to communication and what are the key statutory obligations?

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Right of victims of crime सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern right against untouchability and discrimination?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article art24, No person shall be subjected to any form of untouchability or discrimination in any private or public place.

question: How does the law regulate right relating to property and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to constitution (art25): Every citizen shall have the right to acquire, own, sell, and enjoy property.

reference_answer: Pursuant to labour_act_2017 (s52): Employers must deduct ten percent from the basic remuneration and add an equal match to deposit into the Social Security Fund.

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Gratuity contribution सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: सम्बन्धित ऐनको कानूनी व्यवस्था अनुसार: Employers must deposit gratuity contributions into the Social Security Fund for every labourer.

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern occupational safety policy?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article s68, Every employer employing ten or more labourers must formulate and execute an occupational health and safety policy.

question: How does the law regulate capacity to hold property and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to civil_code_2017 (s18): Every person has legal personality and the capacity to acquire, enjoy, and dispose of property.

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Conditions for marriage सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: सम्बन्धित ऐनको कानूनी व्यवस्था अनुसार: Marriage requires that both the man and woman have attained twenty years of age and give free consent.

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern prohibited degrees of marriage?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article s71, Marriage is prohibited between blood relations within prohibited degrees unless custom permits.

question: How does the law regulate classification of property and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to civil_code_2017 (s205): Property is classified as movable and immovable, tangible and intangible, private, public, and government.

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Free consent in contracts सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: सम्बन्धित ऐनको कानूनी व्यवस्था अनुसार: Consent is free when it is not caused by coercion, undue influence, fraud, or misrepresentation.

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern bribery in judicial proceedings?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article s160, Influencing or bribing a judge or arbitrator carries imprisonment up to seven years.

question: How does the law regulate rape offense and punishment and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to penal_code_2017 (s219): Rape is penalized with strict imprisonment ranging from ten to twenty years or life depending on age of victim.

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Cheating (fraud) सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: सम्बन्धित ऐनको कानूनी व्यवस्था अनुसार: Cheating by deceit or dishonest inducement carries imprisonment up to seven years and fine up to seventy thousand rupees.

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern investigation by police?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article s15, Investigating police officers are empowered to interrogate witnesses and collect forensic evidence.

question: How does the law regulate remand in custody and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to criminal_procedure_code_2017 (s59): The judicial authority may remand an arrested accused in custody for investigation up to twenty-five days maximum.

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Pollution prevention सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: सम्बन्धित ऐनको कानूनी व्यवस्था अनुसार: No person shall emit pollutants exceeding prescribed national standards into air, water, or soil.

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern exemption from income tax?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article s24, Certain manufacturing and export-oriented industries enjoy income tax holidays for up to five years.

question: How does the law regulate approval authority and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to fitta_2019 (s15): The Department of Industry or Investment Board of Nepal serves as the foreign investment approval authority.

question: नेपालको कानून अनुसार Inquiry on complaints सम्बन्धी के कस्तो कानूनी व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
reference_answer: सम्बन्धित ऐनको कानूनी व्यवस्था अनुसार: The NHRC may investigate complaints lodged by victims or initiate suo motu inquiries into human rights violations.

question: Under the prevailing legal framework, what specific rules govern right to equality?
reference_answer: Under Section/Article art18, Every citizen shall have equal protection of the law and no citizen shall be discriminated against on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or origin.

question: How does the law regulate right to communication and what are the key statutory obligations?
reference_answer: Pursuant to constitution (art19): No prior censorship shall be made on publication or broadcasting through electronic or print media.
